fact_english: The kamagong or mabolo tree belongs to the same genus as ebony trees, and its fuzzy fruit is called the velvet apple.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang mabolo o kamagong, kamag-anak ng ebony, at ang malambot-balbon nitong prutas, tinatawag na velvet apple!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Mansanas na naka-sweater. Bagay sa tag-ulan.

after_text: Nasa unahan siya ng bangka, tumatahol sa bawat bubong na may tao.
why_here: After the rescue montage ends on Usman barking from the bow (he has just made his own small joke), before the second night and Sinag.
